verdict.rationale: OpenCode's GitHub integration lets it respond automatically to issues/PRs (working in a new branch and submitting a PR), and its permission system can auto-approve actions — both are event-like automations, but there's no documented general-purpose rules/hooks engine for arbitrary triggers-to-actions. missing for 10: a documented rules/hooks system for defining custom event-trigger-action mappings beyond GitHub PR/issue flows, evidence of configurable event types, and independent confirmation of reliability.
